eps.t: Anemone Flaccida and Queen of the Night
eps.ov: Yu has a passion for accessories. His best friend is his biggest supporter. But are they really just friends?
Yu ponders his next product, and Himari forms a plan to bring Yu and Rion closer together.

eps.t: Tulips and the Face of Love
eps.ov: Yu grapples with the reveal of Rion as his first crush, as his relationship with Himari begins to shift.
Himari's decision to break off her friendship with Yu causes a rift in their relationship.

eps.t: A Hunk and Morning Glory Yutaka
eps.ov: Yu reconciles with Himari, but finds himself at risk of failing classes.
Rion is determined to participate in the study group to try to get closer to Yu.
The leak of Yu's identity as the creator of You leaves him juggling an uptick in orders from schoolmates.
After his work results in troubles at school, Yu contemplates quitting his craft in accessories.
Ahead of summer break, Yu admits his feelings for Himari. Meanwhile, Kureha visits to offer Yu a deal.
Yu, Himari, and Rion look for inspo for Yu's masterpiece during summer break.
With his decision to feature sunflowers, Yu works on his masterpiece to go head to head with Kureha.

eps.t: Flowers that Bloom Along the Path of Dreams
eps.ov: As Yu and Himari decide to part ways for their dreams, along comes Himari's day of departure.
